metric: Original per-query candidate list, first target positive; exact text equality

download.scope: Official files downloaded and hashed only; inference reproduction pending; remote code not executed.

validation_protocol.selection: All validation records; pair(random.Random(record.id)); sorted source then id
validation_protocol.candidates: All same-source validation targets, including duplicate targets
validation_protocol.positives: Exact training positive_mask; normalized answers or overlapping image/caption keys
validation_protocol.ties: First candidate in record-id order, exactly as training validation
validation_protocol.types: Question/source-only heuristic v1; not official question-type annotation

provenance.selection: No fitting or model/prompt selection; evaluate fixed official weights.
provenance.scope: Seen diagnostic validation and ScienceQA. Restricted image budget; not paper headline reproduction.
provenance.pretraining_contamination: Unknown; benchmark may occur in upstream embedding training.
